preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(int(digit) for digit in str(int(''.join(str(ord(char)) for char in input_string)))) - sum(int(digit) for digit in str(int(''.join(str(ord(char) if ord(char) != 55 else 49) for char in input_string))))
postconditions.description: The return value is the difference between the sum of the digits in total1 and the sum of the digits in total2.
